name: Malaysian Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce & Cucumber Salad (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Animator's Palate (Animation Magic Night 2)
whyItWorks: Grilled chicken tenders with smooth peanut satay sauce provide lean protein and soluble peanut fats.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the peanut sauce on the side to check spice level (avoid if heavy sambal chili is blended in) and skip the raw cucumber peel salad.
watchOuts: Crushed peanuts if not blended smooth
